9	/**
10	 * Edit a GX check. The expectation Select (grouped by category) drives which
11	 * config fields render (from the expectation catalog); the submitted `config` is
12	 * rebuilt from only the selected expectation's declared fields, so switching
13	 * types never leaks stale kwargs. Creating a check is the dedicated
14	 * `/suites/:suiteId/checks/new` page, not this drawer.
15	 */
16	export function CheckDrawer({
17	  open,
18	  suiteId,
19	  check,
20	  onClose,
21	  onSaved,
22	}: {
23	  open: boolean;
24	  suiteId: string;
25	  check?: Check;
26	  onClose: () => void;
27	  onSaved: () => void;
28	}) {
29	  const { message } = App.useApp();
30	  const [form] = Form.useForm();
31	  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
32	  const selectedType = Form.useWatch('expectation_type', form) as string | undefined;
33	  const spec = selectedType ? EXPECTATION_BY_TYPE[selectedType] : undefined;
34	
35	  // Reset first (antd keeps values for unmounted fields, so stale config can
36	  // survive an open→close→open with a different check), then prefill.
37	  useEffect(() => {
38	    if (!open || !check) return;
39	    form.resetFields();
40	    form.setFieldsValue({
41	      name: check.name,
42	      expectation_type: check.expectation_type,
43	      config: configToForm(EXPECTATION_BY_TYPE[check.expectation_type], check.config),
44	      warn_threshold: check.warn_threshold ?? undefined,
45	      fail_threshold: check.fail_threshold ?? undefined,
46	      critical_threshold: check.critical_threshold ?? undefined,
47	    });
48	  }, [open, check, form]);
49	
50	  const onSubmit = async () => {
51	    if (!check) return;
52	    let values: Record<string, unknown>;
53	    try {
54	      values = await form.validateFields();
55	    } catch {
56	      return; // inline validation errors
57	    }
58	    const payload = buildCheckPayload(values);
59	    setSubmitting(true);
60	    try {
61	      await updateCheck(suiteId, check.id, payload);
62	      message.success(`${payload.name}: saved`);
63	      onSaved();
64	    } catch (err) {
65	      message.error(`Save failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'unknown error'}`);
66	    } finally {
67	      setSubmitting(false);
68	    }
69	  };
70	
71	  return (
72	    <Drawer
73	      title={check ? `Edit “${check.name}”` : 'Edit check'}
74	      open={open}
75	      onClose={onClose}
76	      width={520}
77	      destroyOnHidden
78	      extra={
79	        <Flex gap={8}>
80	          <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
81	          <Button type="primary" loading={submitting} onClick={onSubmit}>
82	            Save
83	          </Button>
84	        </Flex>
85	      }
86	    >
87	      <Form form={form} layout="vertical">
88	        <Form.Item name="name" label="Name" rules={[{ required: true }]}>
89	          <Input placeholder="e.g. order_id not null" />
90	        </Form.Item>
91	        <Form.Item name="expectation_type" label="Expectation" rules={[{ required: true }]}>
92	          <Select
93	            placeholder="Select an expectation"
94	            // Grouped by category (antd optgroups) — the GX-Cloud-style picker.
95	            options={EXPECTATIONS_BY_CATEGORY.map((g) => ({
96	              label: g.category,
97	              options: g.specs.map((e) => ({ value: e.type, label: e.label })),
98	            }))}
99	          />
100	        </Form.Item>
101	
102	        {spec && (
103	          <>
104	            <Typography.Paragraph type="secondary" style={{ marginTop: -8 }}>
105	              {spec.description}
106	            </Typography.Paragraph>
107	            {spec.fields.map((field) => (
108	              <ConfigFieldItem key={field.name} field={field} />
109	            ))}
110	          </>
111	        )}
112	
113	        <SeverityThresholdFields />
114	      </Form>
115	    </Drawer>
116	  );
117	}

1	import type { CheckCreate } from '../../api/suites';
2	import { EXPECTATION_BY_TYPE, type ExpectationSpec } from './expectationCatalog';
3	
4	/**
5	 * Pure check-authoring form helpers shared by the edit drawer (`CheckDrawer`)
6	 * and the dedicated create page (`CheckNew`): the form↔payload conversions, so
7	 * the two surfaces can't drift on kwarg shaping. The matching field components
8	 * live in `checkFormFields.tsx`.
9	 */
10	
11	/** Split a comma-separated list field into trimmed, non-empty items. */
12	export function parseList(value: unknown): string[] {
13	  return String(value ?? '')
14	    .split(',')
15	    .map((s) => s.trim())
16	    .filter(Boolean);
17	}
18	
19	function numOrNull(v: unknown): number | null {
20	  return typeof v === 'number' ? v : null;
21	}
22	
23	/** Build the GX `config` kwargs from only the selected expectation's fields. */
24	function formToConfig(
25	  spec: ExpectationSpec | undefined,
26	  raw: Record<string, unknown>,
27	): Record<string, unknown> {
28	  const config: Record<string, unknown> = {};
29	  if (!spec) return config;
30	  for (const field of spec.fields) {
31	    const value = raw[field.name];
32	    if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') continue;
33	    if (field.type === 'list') {
34	      const items = parseList(value);
35	      if (items.length > 0) config[field.name] = items;
36	    } else {
37	      config[field.name] = value;
38	    }
39	  }
40	  return config;
41	}
42	
43	/** Inverse of formToConfig for edit-mode prefill (list array → comma string). */
44	export function configToForm(
45	  spec: ExpectationSpec | undefined,
46	  config: Record<string, unknown>,
47	): Record<string, unknown> {
48	  const form: Record<string, unknown> = {};
49	  if (!spec) return form;
50	  for (const field of spec.fields) {
51	    const value = config[field.name];
52	    if (value === undefined) continue;
53	    form[field.name] = field.type === 'list' && Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(', ') : value;
54	  }
55	  return form;
56	}
57	
58	/** Assemble the create/update payload from validated form values. Rebuilds
59	 *  `config` from only the selected expectation's fields, so switching types
60	 *  never leaks stale kwargs. */
61	export function buildCheckPayload(values: Record<string, unknown>): CheckCreate {
62	  const spec = EXPECTATION_BY_TYPE[values.expectation_type as string];
63	  return {
64	    name: values.name as string,
65	    expectation_type: values.expectation_type as string,
66	    config: formToConfig(spec, (values.config ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>),
67	    warn_threshold: numOrNull(values.warn_threshold),
68	    fail_threshold: numOrNull(values.fail_threshold),
69	    critical_threshold: numOrNull(values.critical_threshold),
70	  };
71	}
72

{
  "file_path": "/Users/arijit/Coding/Python/DataQ/frontend/src/components/checks/DryRunPreview.tsx",
  "content": "import { Alert, Button, Descriptions, type FormInstance, Flex, Tag, Typography } from 'antd';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\n\nimport { type CheckDryRunResult, dryRunCheck } from '../../api/suites';\nimport { RESULT_STATUS_COLORS } from '../results/resultsFormat';\nimport { buildCheckPayload } from './checkForm';\n\n/**\n * Inline \"preview before saving\" affordance for the check editor: runs the\n * in-progress check against the suite's live target via the dry-run API\n * (`POST /suites/{id}/checks/dryrun`) and shows the severity outcome — without\n * persisting a Run/Result. Shared by the create page (`CheckNew`) and the edit\n * drawer (`CheckDrawer`); both pass the suite's run target (#215) so the same\n * `table`/`schema` the run would use is previewed.\n *\n * v1 backend limits (surfaced as the API's error message): dry-run needs a\n * table target and a Snowflake connection. The button is disabled (with a\n * reason) until an expectation is picked and the suite has a table target;\n * everything else (no credential, unreachable warehouse, wrong datasource) comes\n * back as a clean error from the API and renders in the alert.\n */\nexport function DryRunPreview({\n  suiteId,\n  expectationType,\n  target,\n  form,\n}: {\n  suiteId: string;\n  expectationType: string | undefined;\n  target: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n  form: FormInstance;\n}) {\n  const [state, setState] = useState<\n    | { status: 'idle' }\n    | { status: 'running' }\n    | { status: 'ok'; result: CheckDryRunResult }\n    | { status: 'error'; error: string }\n  >({ status: 'idle' });\n\n  const table = typeof target?.table === 'string' ? target.table : undefined;\n  const schema = typeof target?.schema === 'string' ? target.schema : null;\n\n  const disabledReason = !expectationType\n    ? 'Pick an expectation to preview it.'\n    : !table\n      ? 'Set a table target on the suite to preview against live data.'\n      : undefined;\n\n  const run = async () => {\n    if (!expectationType || !table) return;\n    setState({ status: 'running' });\n    try {\n      // Reuse the create/update payload shaping so the preview runs exactly the\n      // config (and thresholds) the saved check would — name is irrelevant here.\n      const payload = buildCheckPayload({ ...form.getFieldsValue(true), expectationType });\n      const result = await dryRunCheck(suiteId, {\n        expectation_type: expectationType,\n        config: payload.config,\n        warn_threshold: payload.warn_threshold,\n        fail_threshold: payload.fail_threshold,\n        critical_threshold: payload.critical_threshold,\n        table,\n        schema,\n      });\n      setState({ status: 'ok', result });\n    } catch (err) {\n      setState({ status: 'error', error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'unknown error' });\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={8}>\n      <Flex gap={12} align=\"center\">\n        <Button onClick={run} loading={state.status === 'running'} disabled={!!disabledReason}>\n          Dry-run preview\n        </Button>\n        {disabledReason && <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">{disabledReason}</Typography.Text>}\n      </Flex>\n      {state.status === 'ok' && <DryRunResultView result={state.result} />}\n      {state.status === 'error' && (\n        <Alert type=\"error\" showIcon message=\"Dry-run failed\" description={state.error} />\n      )}\n    </Flex>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction DryRunResultView({ result }: { result: CheckDryRunResult }) {\n  return (\n    <Descriptions\n      size=\"small\"\n      bordered\n      column={1}\n      styles={{ label: { width: 140 } }}\n      items={[\n        {\n          key: 'status',\n          label: 'Result',\n          children: <Tag color={RESULT_STATUS_COLORS[result.status as never]}>{result.status}</Tag>,\n        },\n        {\n          key: 'metric',\n          label: 'Metric',\n          children: result.metric_value === null ? '—' : result.metric_value,\n        },\n        {\n          key: 'observed',\n          label: 'Observed',\n          children: result.observed_value ? (\n            <Typography.Text code>{JSON.stringify(result.observed_value)}</Typography.Text>\n          ) : (\n            '—'\n          ),\n        },\n        {\n          key: 'expected',\n          label: 'Expected',\n          children: result.expected_value ? (\n            <Typography.Text code>{JSON.stringify(result.expected_value)}</Typography.Text>\n          ) : (\n            '—'\n          ),\n        },\n      ]}\n    />\n  );\n}\n"
}

## Review summary

I reviewed `git diff main...HEAD` for `feature/pr-d1-dryrun`, grounding each claim against `checkForm.ts`, `useAsyncData.ts`, `checks.py` (backend contract), `resultsFormat.ts`, `runs.ts`, and both consuming surfaces.

**Confirmed correct (no bug):**
- Request shaping: `buildCheckPayload({...form.getFieldsValue(true), expectation_type})` is right — `getFieldsValue(true)` returns `{config, name, warn/fail/critical_threshold}`, and `buildCheckPayload` rebuilds `config` from only the selected expectation's fields, mapping thresholds via `numOrNull` (number|null, accepted by the backend `Decimal | None`). Test at DryRunPreview.test.tsx:78-88 matches.
- `RESULT_STATUS_COLORS[result.status as ResultStatus]`: an unmapped status yields `undefined` color → antd Tag renders default, no crash.
- Disabled button: antd blocks `onClick` and `run` also guards `if (!expectationType || !table) return`.
- `useAsyncData(() => suiteId ? getSuite(suiteId) : Promise.reject(...))`: a rejected/failed fetch sets `suiteState.status==='error'`, so `target` falls to `null` and the page still renders (button just shows "Set a table target"). No unhandled rejection — the hook `.catch`es. `Descriptions styles={{label}}` and `Form.Item` wrapping are valid antd usage.

**Two findings returned as JSON above**, most severe first:
1. **Stale dry-run result in CheckDrawer** (medium/high) — the result panel's local `state` is never cleared on expectation-type or config change, so in the edit drawer a previous preview stays shown after the user switches expectations or edits config, presented as if current. CheckNew is immune (it unmounts on retype).
2. **Silent schema drop** (low) — a present-but-non-string `target.schema` falls through the `typeof` guard to `null`, previewing against the default schema with no error.
